response.rationale: The item is defective (screen failure confirmed) and not final sale. RET-020 (priority 90) allows defective returns regardless of the standard or electronics window, overriding the out-of-window ineligibility rules RET-003 and RET-008 (priority 20 and 10). No final-sale (RET-012) or fraud-hold (RET-051) conditions apply.
